title: Part - Time Instructor, Economics - FY 2027
description:
Part - Time Instructor, Economics - FY 2027



Job Description

Core Responsibilities


Teach college-level courses in the field.

Develop syllabi and course materials.

Evaluate student mastery of skills and competencies required by
course outcomes.

Provide an excellent teaching experience as well as student
advisement, recruitment activities and program/curriculum
development.

Teach at multiple campuses in Clark County.

Be available to teach day, evening and/or weekend
courses.




Required Qualifications


Master's degree in Economics from a regionally accredited
college or university with 18 graduate credits in the subject being
taught from a regionally accredited college or university.




Preferred Qualifications


Doctorate Degree in Economics from a regionally accredited
college or university.




Salary

$925.00 per credit hour. Courses/Credits assigned may vary by
semester.

Applications will be considered on an as-needed basis determined
by course availability.

Exempt

Yes

Full-Time Equivalent

48.8%

Required Attachment(s)

To be considered for this position, candidates must attach the
following documents:


Resume/CV

Cover Letter

Unofficial Transcript
